observer.help: /obs <structure|feature|biome|block|entity> <name>; continuous tracking; /obs clear [category name]; /obs list (click a query for results).
observer.cleared_all: Cleared all Observer queries, tracking, navigation and highlights.
observer.cleared: Cleared tracking, highlights and navigation for %1$s %2$s.
observer.query_limit: Query limit reached (%s). Clear unused queries; /obs list shows active queries.
observer.started: Query #%1$s %2$s %3$s: searching loaded client data; tracking until cleared, reporting target changes.
observer.heuristic: Structures/features are heuristic candidates with estimated bounds; player builds may also match.
observer.search_failed: Search failed. See the client log.
observer.query_expired: This query is no longer active.
observer.target_expired: The target changed, unloaded or the link expired. Refresh the results.
observer.target_hover: Click to face and track this target. %s
observer.list_summary: Active queries: %1$s; indexed sections: %2$s/%3$s; pending: %4$s; outlines: %5$s/%6$s. Loaded client data only.
observer.query_hover: Click to show current results for this query.
observer.evidence.dungeon: Spawner, mossy floor and rectangular cobblestone walls.
observer.evidence.treasure: Chest at chunk offset (9,9), matching base and surrounding materials; loot not checked.
observer.evidence.biome: Received 4×4×4 biome sample; nearest matching position per chunk.
observer.evidence.lava: Small connected lava-source volume; natural and artificial pools cannot be distinguished.
observer.evidence.hut: Cauldron and flower pot match vanilla relative offsets; wood is not required.
observer.evidence.mineshaft: Paired two-block fence supports, rails/cobwebs and received passage connections; intersecting generation origins cannot be distinguished.
observer.evidence.fossil: Overworld bone-block skeleton; ore cover is not required.
observer.evidence.lava_rule: Local overworld lava pool; generator origin is unknown.
observer.evidence.dungeon_rule: Spawner center with a 5/7-block chamber and mossy floor.
observer.evidence.amethyst_geode: Amethyst interior, calcite middle and smooth basalt exterior.
observer.evidence.ruined_portal: Broken obsidian frame with netherrack/magma; variant inferred from received biome.
observer.evidence.village: Village biome, building materials and beds/workstations/bells.
observer.evidence.ancient_city: Deepslate architecture with reinforced deepslate or soul lanterns and wool.
observer.evidence.end_city: Purpur buildings with end stone bricks/end rods.
observer.evidence.shipwreck: Hull, chest and required wooden trapdoors; any orientation.
observer.evidence.ocean_ruin_warm: Ocean sandstone ruins with suspicious sand/chest.
observer.evidence.ocean_ruin_cold: Ocean stone/mossy ruins with a chest or suspicious gravel.
observer.evidence.stronghold: Stone brick variants with iron doors/end portal frames.
observer.evidence.igloo: Snow shelter with ice windows, carpet and furnace; basement may be unloaded.
observer.evidence.jungle_pyramid: Mossy cobblestone, tripwire hooks and dispensers.
observer.evidence.pillager_outpost: Dark wood tower, birch planks and fences.
observer.evidence.mansion: Dark oak shell, birch interior and window panes.
observer.evidence.treasure_rule: Chest at chunk offset (9,9), vanilla base and surrounding materials.
